title: License Board grid (licd) — battlepack section 70 and board_1-12.bin

container.notes: licd grid, little-endian. Found as battlepack section 70 (locate through the battle_pack.bin offset table; offsets relative to the section start; last section of the pack) and as the standalone files board_1.bin .. board_12.bin (whole file = one board, game file ids 0x47-0x52). 8-byte header (magic 'licd', u16 columnCount, u16 rowCount), then columnCount*rowCount u16 cells stored row-major (cell(r,c) at 8 + 2*(r*W + c)), then zero padding to a multiple of 16.

records.name: header
records.where: Offset 0 of the board: start of battlepack section 70, or start of a board_N.bin file.

fields.name: magic
fields.notes: ASCII 'licd' (6C 69 63 64); reject the data if different.

records.name: cell
records.where: offset 8 + 2*(row*header.columnCount + column) from the start of the board; cells are stored row by row (all columns of row 0, then row 1, ...); row-major, NOT the column-major nesting of the Workshop JSON

fields.name: licenseNode
fields.notes: License placed on this square: a section 12 row id (0-367). Squares without a license hold a sentinel, expected 0xFFFF (unverified).

roundTrip: Keep the magic 'licd' and keep columnCount/rowCount equal to the real grid (cell count = W*H).
Cells are row-major: (row r, column c) at 8 + 2*(r*W + c). Do not write the Workshop JSON's column-first nesting to disk.
Edit cells in place for moves/additions/removals; nothing else in the file changes.
Copy cell values that are not license ids (the empty sentinel) unchanged.
Keep the trailing zero padding to a multiple of 16; when the dimensions are unchanged keep the original file/section length byte for byte.
Dimension change: rewrite the whole cell array, re-pad to 16; for section 70 also update the battlepack end-of-data offset (section 70 is the last section).
Do not renumber section 12 rows without rewriting every board that references them.
gaps: VBF folder of board_1.bin .. board_12.bin is not stated by the sources.
Cell value = section 12 row id: expected from context, not stated explicitly.
Vanilla grid dimensions (24 x 24 expected) and whether vanilla files are padded to 16.
Which job each board_N.bin belongs to, and what the section 70 board is used for (possibly the Classic Board, JobList 12).
Neighbour/adjacency rule for unlocking squares, and how far W/H can grow before the menu breaks.
